title: Time to move on to another engine.

posts.author: Lars Ulrika
posts.body:
Hello everybody!
That's with a mixed feeling of a heavy heart and excitement that I announce that I won't be around here for a while. My game project turned out to be much more than a classic jrpg and this weekend's issues made me realize that Rpg maker MZ won't cut it, or if it does, it would be excruciatingly painful to put together.
So I decided to just pack things up and move on to a more versatile engine. The gameplay and philosophy got to a point where the built-in database isn't that needed, and smart pathfinding, pixel movement and collision, specific battle systems involving movement are needed much more badly, so I think it's probably the best decision I can make at this point.
I feel sad leaving the rpg maker community because I spent lots of years fooling around with the software (since the Don Miguel rpg maker 2000 to be precise) and I grew to love the community here so much. So I want to thank you all for everything, for the welcoming atmosphere, the jokes and the support.
If you wanna keep in touch, I have the same pseudo on Steam. I wish you all the best and to find success with your projects!
I might pass by now and then to keep track of what is being cooked up here, but that should be very very sporadically (unless I finally start that youtube channel testing your games, but for now I don't have the time to get this started).
Smooches and hugs to everybody, love you!

posts.author: Mcniner
posts.body: I applaud you for moving on to a new game engine because it suits your project more. It shows a dedication to your work, because you want to to be completed right, not just completed.
